api/api/SharedLibrary.Managers.TasksMana.summary: Class TasksManager Manages player self-care Tasks: suggests tasks, lets the player accept them, and completes Tasks. Inheritance object TasksManager Inherited Members object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ToString() Namespace: SharedLibrary.Managers Assembly: SharedLibrary.dll Syntax public class TasksManager Remarks The manager initializes a pool of self-care tasks from an embedded JSON resource (for now, then use tasks from balance) and uses it to populate SuggestionTasks for a player. Suggestions are kept unique relative to the player's current ActiveTasks and existing suggestions. Methods | Edit this page View Source AddMTaskFromSuggestions(Player, string) Moves a suggested Task to the player's active Tasks and replenishes the suggestions list. Declaration public PlayerTasks AddMTaskFromSuggestions(Player player, string taskId) Parameters Type Name Description Player player The target player who accepts the Task. string taskId The identifier of the Task taken from SuggestionTasks. Returns Type Description PlayerTasks The player's PlayerTasks after the operation. Remarks If the Task with the given taskId exists in SuggestionTasks, it is added to ActiveTasks (if not already present) and removed from suggestions. The method then picks the next available task from the internal pool that is not present in either list and adds it to SuggestionTasks to keep suggestions capped and unique. Examples var updated = manager.AddMTaskFromSuggestions(player, "self_care_20"); // The Task is now in ActiveTasks; suggestions were replenished. | Edit this page View Source CompleteTask(Player, string) Marks an active task as completed and applies its rewards to the player. Declaration public Player CompleteTask(Player player, string taskId) Parameters Type Name Description Player player The player who completes the task. string taskId The identifier of the task in ActiveTasks to complete. Returns Type Description Player The updated Player after rewards have been applied. Remarks The task is not removed from ActiveTasks; only its CompleteDate is set to UtcNow. For each entry in Result, the corresponding resource is added via player.AddResource(resourceType, bigVal). If the task is not found, the method returns the player unchanged. Examples var updatedPlayer = manager.CompleteTask(player, "self_care_20"); | Edit this page View Source CreateTask(Player, TaskCare) Adds a manually created task to the player's active tasks. Declaration public PlayerTasks CreateTask(Player player, TaskCare task) Parameters Type Name Description Player player The player to whom the manual task will be added. TaskCare task The manually created task instance. Returns Type Description PlayerTasks The player's PlayerTasks after the new task has been added. Remarks This method generates a unique identifier for the new task and assigns default rewards for DreamStones and Energy based on UserTaskDreamStones and UserTaskEnergy. The task is then added to ActiveTasks. Examples var manualTask = new TaskCare { Title = "Write a journal entry", CategoryId = "self_reflection", Date = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(5), Repeat = TimeSpan.FromDays(1) }; var updatedTasks = manager.CreateTask(player, manualTask); // The player now has the new manual task in ActiveTasks. Exceptions Type Condition ArgumentNullException Thrown when player or task is null. | Edit this page View Source GetPlayerTasks(Player) Gets the player's tasks, autopopulating suggestions on the first call. Declaration public PlayerTasks GetPlayerTasks(Player player) Parameters Type Name Description Player player The target player whose tasks are requested. Returns Type Description PlayerTasks The player's PlayerTasks, including suggestions and active tasks. Remarks If SuggestionTasks is empty, the method fills it with up to TasksMaxSuggestions available tasks from the internal pool, ensuring no duplicates with ActiveTasks or existing suggestions. Examples var manager = new TasksManager(); var tasks = manager.GetPlayerTasks(player); // tasks.SuggestionTasks is now populated (if it was empty) | Edit this page View Source RemoveTask(Player, string) Removes a task with the specified identifier from the player's active tasks. Declaration public PlayerTasks RemoveTask(Player player, string taskId) Parameters Type Name Description Player player The player whose task should be removed. string taskId The unique identifier of the task to remove from ActiveTasks. Returns Type Description PlayerTasks The player's PlayerTasks after the specified task has been removed. Remarks This method searches the player's ActiveTasks collection for a task matching the provided taskId and removes it if found. If no matching task exists, the player's tasks remain unchanged. Examples var updatedTasks = manager.RemoveTask(player, "self_care_20"); // The task with the given ID is no longer in ActiveTasks. Exceptions Type Condition ArgumentNullException Thrown when player is null. | Edit this page View Source UpdateTask(Player, TaskCare) Updates an existing active Task by replacing it with the provided instance. Declaration public PlayerTasks UpdateTask(Player player, TaskCare task) Parameters Type Name Description Player player The player whose Task should be updated. TaskCare task The Task to put in place of the existing one. Matching is performed by Id. Returns Type Description PlayerTasks The player's PlayerTasks after the update operation. Remarks The method searches ActiveTasks for an item with the same Id as the provided task. If found, the existing item is replaced with task. If no matching Task is found, the player's tasks remain unchanged. Examples var updated = manager.UpdateTask(player, new TaskSelfCare { Id = "self_care_20", Title = "New Title" }); // ActiveTasks now contains the updated Task instance for Id "self_care_20".
